name: UN Comtrade API
summary: Official UN trade statistics by reporter, partner and commodity; a keyless preview route returns up to 500 records, full queries need a free subscription key.
description: UN Comtrade collects detailed annual and monthly trade data reported by countries, classified by HS, SITC and BEC commodity codes and by partner and mode of transport. The comtradeapi.un.org service has a keyless preview route (public/v1/preview) that returns at most 500 records per query, and a full data route (data/v1/get) that requires a free subscription key. Reference lists of reporters, partners and commodity codes are plain JSON files that need no key.

auth.notes: The public/v1/preview route needs no key and returns up to 500 records. The data/v1/get route answered 401 'missing subscription key' without one; a free key is issued through the UN Comtrade developer portal.

rate_limit.summary: Fair-use policy with a per-second rate limit and a daily call quota that UN Comtrade may adjust; no numbers confirmed for the keyless preview.

endpoints.summary: Keyless preview of up to 500 trade records (typeCode C goods or S services, freqCode A or M, clCode e.g. HS)
Full trade data query (free subscription key required)
Harmonized System commodity codes (keyless reference list)

license.name: UN Comtrade policy on data use; the UN Statistics Division must be cited as source

coverage.geographic: Global; about 200 reporters and their partners
coverage.temporal: Historical to recent years; annual and monthly

agent_notes: Codes are numeric M49-style country codes (842 = USA, 0 = World) and HS commodity codes (TOTAL = all). The preview route does not name countries (reporterDesc, partnerDesc and cmdDesc come back null); join with the Reporters.json and HS.json files. Totals queries (cmdCode=TOTAL, partnerCode=0) are the quickest way to get a country-level figure. For more than 500 rows use the data route with a key or the bulk files.
caveats: Sending an Origin header (as browsers do) to the preview route returned HTTP 200 with an empty body, so it cannot be called from browser JavaScript; use a server-side client.

The keyless public/v1/preview route is the one the UN Comtrade web tool uses; the documentation describes the preview feature (up to 500 records) but this record did not find the route spelled out as a public contract, so it may change.
The full data/v1/get route was only observed returning 401 without a key (not tested with a key).
Mirror trade flows (exports of A to B vs imports of B from A) disagree; see the Comtrade FAQ on bilateral asymmetries.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key, no Origin header; 200 with application/json. data/v1/get answered 401 without a key.
